verdict.rationale: The GitHub README directly claims a 'Real-time Monitoring Dashboard with live system metrics and browser pool visibility,' which matches the core of the story. The dashboard sits alongside the Dockerized FastAPI server deployment. The evidence is a single feature-list line, though, with no depth on what is shown or how to access it. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the dashboard's metrics and access, explicit evidence of worker/queue status (beyond browser pool), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
